subject: pe
title: Skill & Tactics: Attacking & Defending
welcome_lead: Attack creates space; defence shuts it down. Both win games.
meta_desc: KS3 PE: attacking and defending principles, support.
final_note: Knowing when to attack — and when to fall back — is half the game.

concepts.def: Trying to score or gain ground.
Helping a teammate by being available.
Quick attack after winning the ball.

walkthroughs.body_html: Good attackers find space by running off the ball. Teammates support by being ready for a pass.
Pressing defenders close down quickly to win the ball. Slower defending stays compact and waits.
Win the ball, look up, attack fast. A counter attack catches the other team out of shape.
